dayCarry.daySymbols: Latin d and the active locale day unit

clockContext.snapshot: one shared system clock snapshot per calculation
clockContext.defaultOffset: current system offset from the same snapshot
clockContext.copyAndConfirmation: coherent already displayed ready result set

partialQuickConfirmation.freeze: already displayed calculation and clock snapshot after partial failure
partialQuickConfirmation.retry: finish same pending confirmation; do not duplicate an already saved history entry
partialQuickConfirmation.escape: cancel pending confirmation, keep window open, recalculate with current clock
partialQuickConfirmation.fullRestart: recalculate saved input with current clock

arithmetic.clockDifference: same reference day; preserve explicit carried days
arithmetic.dayCarry: preserve signed day count; display 01:30 (+1d) for 23:30 + 2h
arithmetic.dateTimeDifference: account for fixed offsets without seasonal changes
arithmetic.calendarMonthOverflow: last existing day of target month
arithmetic.datePlusClockTime: either order; combine including signed day carry; explicit clock offset wins, otherwise shared system offset
arithmetic.dateVsDateTime: for subtraction and comparison promote date to 00:00 at shared current system offset
arithmetic.clockVsDatedValue: requires a supplied date; do not guess
arithmetic.absoluteMomentAddition: unsupported except the explicit date-plus-clock composition

output.copy: whole displayed answer, including any displayed offset and day carry
output.calendarPeriodCopy: whole displayed compound period; ordinary fixed duration still copies its numeric coefficient only
output.workingSubmillisecondParts: retain using shared working numerical precision
output.calendarTimeDisplayRounding: nearest millisecond; exact ties toward later time
output.roundingStage: final calendar-time display and copy only; not each arithmetic step or ordinary duration results
output.roundingCarry: propagate through seconds, midnight, date and clock day carry; validate year range

fixedOffsets.explicitOffsetDisplay: retain through arithmetic, names and copying; explicit conversion shows target offset

applyOrder: apply one month shift with last-day clamp
calendarPeriod.separateAdditionOperators: apply sequentially; do not reorder AST operations
operations: multiply or divide entire period by scalar
calendarPeriod.fractionalMonths: allowed in intermediates; total must be integral when applied to a date
calendarPeriod.zeroMonthComponent: normalize to ordinary fixed duration, including ordinary numeric-only copy
calendarPeriod.financialPeriodCounts: remain numerical counts; no implicit calendar-period conversion
calendarPeriod.periodDividedByPeriod: not introduced by the scalar arithmetic contract
calendarPeriod.display: descending components; group complete 12 months into years; omit zeros; explicit signs for opposing parts
calendarPeriod.copy: whole displayed calendar period including units and both components
calendarPeriod.explicitTargetFormat: retain supported target by the existing conversion rule

comparison.equality: compare normalized total months and fixed duration components
comparison.inequality: negation of component equality under ordinary lazy-value comparison rules
comparison.mixedPeriodOrCalendarVsFixedOrdering: requires a supplied reference date; otherwise a brief diagnostic
comparison.referenceDate: apply each period to the same supplied date, then compare the resulting dated values
